verdict.rationale: Motion ships a live public REST API with documented X-API-Key auth, available to all users and covering creating, updating and managing projects and tasks. Nothing shows UI parity: the UI's meeting booking, scheduling templates, AI notetaker, search, workflow builder, dashboards and capacity planning have no documented API equivalents. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage beyond projects and tasks (calendar, meetings, booking, AI features, reports), any explicit parity statement, and independent hands-on confirmation of API breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: API access for creating, updating, and managing projects and tasks.
